summary: The current workspace, scoped Git diff, workspace assertions, and deterministic post-actor checks agree that the removed support agent was retired coherently.

requirements.evidence: Current moldea/moldea.yaml contains only version 1 and the /moldea/project.md context declaration; it has no support agent, runtimeAgent binding, custom runtime guidance, or support-agent reference. The scoped diff removes the complete agents.support manifest block, including runtime id/guidance and binding, and deletes the support description, instruction, and custom runtime guidance files. Direct checks confirm those canonical paths and src/support-agent.ts are absent. Workspace assertions identify exactly the four intended canonical changes, while deterministic post-actor validation reports a valid schema-4 repository, passing typecheck, zero failures, and no validation-time mutation.
